purpose.domain_detail: NIST COBOL 85 conformance test suite — indexed file I/O validation
purpose.summary: This program is part of the NIST COBOL 85 validation test suite (IX1024.2). It tests random access to an indexed file created by a companion program (IX101), verifying 500 records, selectively updating them, and re-verifying accuracy. It exercises SELECT...ASSIGN TO with a literal assignment name.

notable_features: NIST COBOL 85 test suite structure with X-card placeholders
Indexed file random access (ORGANIZATION INDEXED, ACCESS MODE RANDOM)
RECORD KEY and multi-assignment ASSIGN clause
No EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS, no COMP-3
verdict.notes: Source is truncated to first 16000 chars (~288 of 698 lines). The file sequence numbers and program name suffix in columns 73-80 (IX1024.2) confirm NIST test suite fixed-format layout. The IBM compiler diagnostic comment (IGYDS1298-I) on line 007400 suggests this copy was processed or annotated in an IBM mainframe environment, but the program itself is the standard NIST suite.
